name: Acetone
description: Colorless, highly flammable liquid. Causes serious eye irritation. May cause drowsiness or dizziness. Keep away from ignition sources.

name: Hydrochloric Acid 33%
description: Corrosive aqueous solution. Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. May cause respiratory irritation.

name: Ethanol 96%
description: Colorless, highly flammable liquid. Causes serious eye irritation. Keep away from heat, sparks, and open flames.

name: Caustic Soda 30%
description: Sodium hydroxide solution. Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. May be corrosive to metals.

name: Methanol
description: Highly flammable liquid. Toxic if swallowed, inhaled, or in contact with skin. May cause damage to organs, including the optic nerve.

name: Bleach
description: Sodium hypochlorite solution. Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. Very toxic to aquatic life. Never mix with acids (chlorine gas may be released).

name: Propane
description: Extremely flammable gas, liquefied under pressure. May explode if heated. Store in a well-ventilated place away from sunlight.

name: Gasoline
description: Extremely flammable liquid. May be fatal if swallowed and enters airways. Suspected of causing cancer. Toxic to aquatic life.
